curriculum.subject: English Language Activities
curriculum.outcomeText: pick out the sounds: / ʃ/, /tʃ/, /θ/ and /ð/ from a text

interactions.prompt: Which word begins with /ʃ/, the sound in shoe?
interactions.retryHint: Listen for the quiet sh sound.

interactions.prompt: Match each sound to its clue word.
interactions.feedback: Great! You found all four sound families.

interactions.prompt: Read: The child has three shells. Which word starts with /tʃ/?
interactions.retryHint: Listen for ch at the beginning.

interactions.prompt: Read: Three thin sticks. Which two words begin with /θ/?
interactions.feedback: Yes! Both begin with the quiet th sound /θ/.
interactions.retryHint: Find the words starting with th where the voice is quiet.

interactions.prompt: Read: This is their shop. Which words begin with the voiced /ð/?
interactions.feedback: Excellent! Your voice buzzes in this and their.
interactions.retryHint: Touch your throat and find the buzzing th words.
Use the clue words: sh, ch, quiet th, buzzing th.
